summary: A local generator run would have overwritten curated Foundation Readiness content with a narrower TARGET-075-only decision. The change was rejected, the curated file was restored, and the generator now blocks silent overwrites of post-TARGET-075 evidence sections unless an explicit override is used after manual review. Playwright auth was refreshed against playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE and is currently usable for the next gated read-first work. The active handoff was then rechecked: PWS-FF-002C, Dimensions and Master Data read-first evidence are already consumed, so the next practical pilot is VAT-POSTING-SETUP-READFIRST rather than another completed Foundation microcase.
